nativeDataPatterns.training: Real weekday strip or named rotating cycle; planned is distinct from completed.
nativeDataPatterns.activityChart: Actual sessions aggregated for selected Week / Month / All time; zero-data message. Progress Week runs Saturday through Friday, orders buckets Sat/Sun/Mon/Tue/Wed/Thu/Fri, and shows the exact date range below its count. Exclude dates outside that Saturday-to-next-Saturday interval without changing stored dates or training schedules. Width is max(available width, bucket count * textScaler.scale(12) * 3): week fits an ordinary phone; enlarged labels or more buckets may scroll horizontally.
nativeDataPatterns.finishReview: Opening review snapshots completion time. Save persists the displayed duration and completion date despite waiting or crossing midnight. Keep training continues the session; reopening review takes a fresh snapshot.
nativeDataPatterns.measurements: Actual finite values; trend requires at least two measurements.
nativeDataPatterns.units: Convert input/display values; preserve kilogram storage.
nativeDataPatterns.appearance: Live preview, named accents, descriptive style rows; immediate three-axis controller.

narrative.overview:
Lockout's built visual system is native Flutter Material 3 Expressive: confident display type, spacious task containers, distinct shaped icon badges and connected rows. The user's chosen accent generates the entire light or dark scheme. Primary, secondary and tertiary containers give different tasks visible character while keeping content readable in rounded rectangles.

The approved forty screen/state concepts establish the composition direction. Their illustrative figures and calendar defects are not product data. This document records the current implementation, rather than proposing a new identity or a web theme. The house system remains immutable; the whole-app deviations govern where it differs.
keyCharacteristics: User-generated color across surfaces and controls.
Bundled expressive display type with readable body text.
Shape changes communicate press, selection and focus.
Real local records determine summaries, schedules and charts.

rules.name: Chosen seed
rules.body: Generate the whole scheme from the user's accent, brightness and style; resolve color through the current theme.

rules.name: Sentence case
rules.body: Use sentence case for app-authored text; preserve user-entered names and normalize stored weekday tags only for presentation.

rules.name: Shape is a state
rules.body: Interactive surfaces carry distinct rest and active shapes; irregular geometry belongs to icon containers, never to text or images.

rules.name: Truthful visualization
rules.body: Show actual records for the selected period and describe missing data instead of inventing sample activity.

dos: Do compose rebuilt screens from the Nv house catalog and current theme.
Do use the five chosen seeds and the three persisted scheme styles.
Do allow labels and control heights to grow at large text sizes, with touch targets at least 48dp.
Do propagate a containing row's press/focus state to its shaped icon badge.
Do preserve local data, kilogram storage and conversions at the display/input boundary.
Do confirm native appearance with fresh device captures after implementation changes.
donts: Don't freeze generated primary, secondary, tertiary or surface roles into a replacement palette.
Don't add wallpaper colors, downloaded fonts, decorative stock imagery or background networking.
Don't clip real content into a Material icon silhouette.
Don't import compatibility-only legacy widgets into rebuilt screens.
Don't treat approved concept arithmetic or stale captures as proof of the shipped behavior.
Don't mark the finish review passed while its confirmation captures are pending.
